note: Intonation shaping applied by scripts/audio/voice_prosody.py when a take is installed. targetHz: the character's steady median pitch (shift limited to ±4 semitones); range: scale of pitch movement; endRise: semitones of rise over the last `endDur` seconds (questions); lift: semitones added to the whole line (shouting). tempo: speed factor (1.1 = 10% quicker), pitch unchanged; phoneme timing is rescaled to match.
